mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.RG_DT DESC) AS LISTNUM, B.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL, A.DIVS_CD, A.PPCD, B.WRGD_CTT, A.PRCDOC_CFY, A.PRCDOC_NO, A.PRCDOC_NM, A.DOC_TYP, A.DOC_PART_NO, A.RRD_CFY, A.PRCDOC_RVSN_NO, A.ATCT_NM, A.FNCLC_ID, B.REGPR_ID, B.REGPR_NM, B.RG_DT, TO_CHAR(B.RG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_RG_DT FROM GE_MP_PRCDOC_M A, GE_MP_WORDS_M B WHERE A.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = B.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL AND A.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL} ORDER BY B.RG_DT DESC ) WHERE LISTNUM BETWEEN #{DISPSTART} AND #{DISPEND}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GE_MP_PRCDOC_M A, GE_MP_WORDS_M B WHERE A.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = B.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL AND A.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_WORDS_M ( PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL, WRGD_CTT, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT ) VALUES ( #{PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{WRGD_CTT}, #{REGPR_ID}, #{REGPR_NM}, SYSDATE )
